dark_matter_hypothesis_record.name: generic-gravitational-hypothesis
dark_matter_hypothesis_record.description: A placeholder model record for comparing a proposed dark-matter scenario with gravitational and astrophysical observations.
assumptions: The model must specify quantitative predictions.
Ordinary astrophysical sources and instrumental effects must be considered.
dark_matter_hypothesis_record.warning: A model record is not a detection. Compare predictions with calibrated observations and competing explanations.

limitations: No dark-matter detection algorithm is implemented.
Radio FFT peaks are not automatically classified as artificial signals.
The quantum protocol is a toy simulation, not secure QKD software.
No real telescope, detector, or quantum device is connected.
